sources.renderAdminInternalPrint:
function renderAdminInternalPrint(estimate) { const sheet = document.getElementById("printQuoteSheet"); if (!sheet || !estimate) return; const groups = buildAdminMarginGroups(estimate, { groupLabels: quoteGroupLabels, groupOrder: quoteGroupOrder }); const totalCustomer = groups.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.customer, 0); const totalCost = groups.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.cost, 0); const totalProfit = totalCustomer - totalCost; const totalMarginRate = markupRate(totalProfit, totalCost); sheet.innerHTML = `

내부견적

${estimate.projectName || "상담 프로젝트"}

평형
${estimate.areaPyeong || "-"}평
작성일
${formatDateTime(estimate.savedAt || new Date().toISOString())}
${groups.map((group) => ` `).join("")}
공정고객용내부용마진마진율
${group.label} ${customerWon(group.customer)} ${won(group.cost)} ${won(group.profit)} ${(group.marginRate * 100).toFixed(1)}%
총계 ${customerWon(totalCustomer)} ${won(totalCost)} ${won(totalProfit)} ${(totalMarginRate * 100).toFixed(1)}%
`; }
sources.renderPurchaseOrderPrint:
function renderPurchaseOrderPrint(estimate) { const sheet = document.getElementById("printQuoteSheet"); if (!sheet || !estimate) return; const items = purchaseOrderItems(estimate, quoteGroupLabels); sheet.innerHTML = `

발주내역서

${estimate.projectName || "상담 프로젝트"}

평형
${estimate.areaPyeong || "-"}평
작성일
${formatDateTime(estimate.savedAt || new Date().toISOString())}
${items.length ? items.map((item) => ` `).join("") : ``}
공정품목사양수량예상 원가
${item.process} ${item.item} ${item.spec} ${item.quantity} ${won(item.budget)}
발주 필요 품목이 없습니다.
발주 품목${items.length}개
예상 원가${won(items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.budget, 0))}
`; }
